include(functions/FetchContent_ExcludeFromAll_backport)

include(FetchContent)

if(MINGW)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Prism screen reader integration is not supported with MinGW. Configure with SCREEN_READER_INTEGRATION=OFF.")
endif()

set(_devilutionx_cmake_c_standard_was_defined FALSE)
if(DEFINED CMAKE_C_STANDARD)
  set(_devilutionx_cmake_c_standard_was_defined TRUE)
  set(_devilutionx_cmake_c_standard "${CMAKE_C_STANDARD}")
endif()
set(_devilutionx_cmake_c_standard_required_was_defined FALSE)
if(DEFINED CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED)
  set(_devilutionx_cmake_c_standard_required_was_defined TRUE)
  set(_devilutionx_cmake_c_standard_required "${CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED}")
endif()
set(_devilutionx_cmake_cxx_standard_was_defined FALSE)
if(DEFINED CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD)
  set(_devilutionx_cmake_cxx_standard_was_defined TRUE)
  set(_devilutionx_cmake_cxx_standard "${CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD}")
endif()
set(_devilutionx_cmake_cxx_standard_required_was_defined FALSE)
if(DEFINED CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED)
  set(_devilutionx_cmake_cxx_standard_required_was_defined TRUE)
  set(_devilutionx_cmake_cxx_standard_required "${CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED}")
endif()
set(_devilutionx_cmake_msvc_runtime_library_was_defined FALSE)
if(DEFINED CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY)
  set(_devilutionx_cmake_msvc_runtime_library_was_defined TRUE)
  set(_devilutionx_cmake_msvc_runtime_library "${CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY}")
endif()
set(_devilutionx_cmake_skip_install_rules_was_defined FALSE)
if(DEFINED CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RULES)
  set(_devilutionx_cmake_skip_install_rules_was_defined TRUE)
  set(_devilutionx_cmake_skip_install_rules "${CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RULES}")
endif()
set(_devilutionx_build_shared_libs_was_defined FALSE)
if(DEFINED BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
  set(_devilutionx_build_shared_libs_was_defined TRUE)
  set(_devilutionx_build_shared_libs "${BUILD_SHARED_LIBS}")
endif()

set(PRISM_ENABLE_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PRISM_ENABLE_DEMOS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PRISM_ENABLE_GDEXTENSION OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PRISM_ENABLE_SHIMS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PRISM_ENABLE_TOLK_SHIM OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PRISM_ENABLE_LEGACY_BACKENDS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PRISM_ENABLE_POWER_MANAGEMENT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PRISM_DEPENDENCY_PROVIDER BUNDLED CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(PRISM_BACKEND_DEFAULT OFF CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(PRISM_ENABLE_NVDA_BACKEND ON CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(PRISM_ENABLE_JAWS_BACKEND ON CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(PRISM_ENABLE_UIA_BACKEND ON CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(PRISM_ENABLE_SAPI_BACKEND OFF CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(PRISM_ENABLE_ONECORE_BACKEND OFF CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(PRISM_ENABLE_ZDSR_BACKEND OFF CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(PRISM_ENABLE_ZOOM_TEXT_BACKEND OFF CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(PRISM_ENABLE_SENSE_READER_BACKEND OFF CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(PRISM_ENABLE_PC_TALKER_BACKEND OFF CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(PRISM_ENABLE_BOY_PC_READER_BACKEND OFF CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(PRISM_ENABLE_SYSTEM_ACCESS_BACKEND OFF CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(PRISM_ENABLE_WINDOW_EYES_BACKEND OFF CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
if(MSVC AND CMAKE_AR)
  set(PRISM_LIB_TOOL "${CMAKE_AR}" CACHE FILEPATH "" FORCE)
endif()

set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RULES ON)

FetchContent_Declare_ExcludeFromAll(Prism
  URL https://github.com/ethindp/prism/archive/9911156998b52fee91fb2cb4f71ac793d4e546c7.tar.gz
  URL_HASH SHA256=f8c80ca75b715477722eb6fa6ca787604e7c34c55722af3e62e36fd27b99ba96
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable_ExcludeFromAll(Prism)

set_target_properties(prism PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 17 CXX_STANDARD 23)

if(_devilutionx_cmake_c_standard_was_defined)
  set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD "${_devilutionx_cmake_c_standard}")
else()
  unset(CMAKE_C_STANDARD)
endif()
if(_devilutionx_cmake_c_standard_required_was_defined)
  set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED "${_devilutionx_cmake_c_standard_required}")
else()
  unset(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED)
endif()
if(_devilutionx_cmake_cxx_standard_was_defined)
  set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD "${_devilutionx_cmake_cxx_standard}")
else()
  unset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD)
endif()
if(_devilutionx_cmake_cxx_standard_required_was_defined)
  set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED "${_devilutionx_cmake_cxx_standard_required}")
else()
  unset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED)
endif()
if(_devilutionx_cmake_msvc_runtime_library_was_defined)
  set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "${_devilutionx_cmake_msvc_runtime_library}" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
else()
  unset(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY CACHE)
  unset(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY)
endif()
if(_devilutionx_cmake_skip_install_rules_was_defined)
  set(CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RULES "${_devilutionx_cmake_skip_install_rules}")
else()
  unset(CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RULES)
endif()
if(_devilutionx_build_shared_libs_was_defined)
  set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS "${_devilutionx_build_shared_libs}" CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
else()
  unset(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS CACHE)
  unset(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
endif()
